properties.description: Fixed and independently code-reviewed. Background graph notifications preserve the mounted drafted Node editor while refreshing relations separately. Save commits its captured values and retains newer edits, rebased only to the exact committed fields; later foreign edits still cause a conflict. Exact authored before/after recordings demonstrate the click-loss and in-flight-save fixes. The separate cold-test input problem was reproduced on an inert shell and corrected with the existing application-ready contract, without weakening persistence assertions. The complete browser workload passed 67/67, including foreign-after-commit conflict protection. Independent backend and UI reviews passed. The final native full checkpoint run remains the delivery gate.
